name: usage-bar
description: A Claude Code mod that draws the 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit windows as bars above the prompt, each with percent used, time left and the local reset time, plus an estimate of how long the prompt cache stays warm. Toggled with /usage-bar; refreshes every minute from the last API response, at no cost.

interface.longDescription: A Claude Code mod that draws the 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit windows as bars above the prompt, each with percent used, time left and the local reset time, plus an estimate of how long the prompt cache stays warm. Toggled with /usage-bar; refreshes every minute from the last API response, at no cost. Ships Claude Code hooks that this plugin has not yet adapted for Codex. Automatic hook behavior is disabled here; skill instructions remain advisory.
